{{Top|leg}}
A '''sound-dampening field''', also known as a '''sound dampening system''',<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref> or simply '''dampener field''',<ref name="GG2-2">[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin'', Second Edition]]</ref> was a type of security system. Such a system was included in the [[Kuat Systems Engineering/Legends|Kuat Systems Engineering]] [[Eddicus-class planetary shuttle/Legends|''Eddicus''-class planetary shuttle]] among the [[Shuttle/Legends|craft's]] security suite.
